levothyroxine.use: Prescription medicine used to treat an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism).
warnings: Take on an empty stomach, usually 30–60 minutes before breakfast.
Separate from calcium and iron supplements by about 4 hours.

salbutamol.use: Prescription reliever inhaler used for quick relief of asthma symptoms (wheeze, breathlessness).
warnings: Needing it more often than usual means asthma control should be reviewed.
Use with a spacer if advised.
Severe breathlessness not relieved by the inhaler is an emergency.

budesonide.use: Prescription preventer inhaler used regularly to control airway inflammation in asthma.
warnings: Use every day as prescribed, even when well.
Rinse mouth after use to reduce oral thrush.

prednisolone.use: Prescription steroid for various inflammatory conditions.
warnings: Take with food in the morning as prescribed.
Do not stop longer courses abruptly.

warfarin.use: Prescription anticoagulant used to prevent and treat blood clots.
warnings: Regular INR blood tests required.
Many interactions: avoid NSAIDs/aspirin unless prescribed.
Report unusual bleeding or bruising.

clopidogrel.use: Prescription antiplatelet used to reduce the risk of heart attack and stroke in certain patients.
warnings: Increases bleeding risk.
Do not stop without medical advice.

sertraline.use: Prescription medicine used for depression and certain anxiety disorders.
warnings: Takes a few weeks to work.
Do not stop suddenly.
Increased bleeding risk with NSAIDs.

codeineSyrup.use: Prescription-only cough suppressant in many countries; potential for misuse and dependence.
warnings: Causes drowsiness and constipation.
Risk of dependence and misuse.
Not for children and certain groups.

ondansetron.use: Prescription medicine to prevent nausea and vomiting in certain situations.
warnings: May cause constipation and headache.

albendazole.use: Used to treat certain intestinal worm infections.
warnings: Avoid in pregnancy.
Follow label/prescriber dose.

mebendazole.use: Used to treat threadworm and certain other intestinal worm infections.
warnings: Treat the whole household for threadworm and follow hygiene measures.
Not for children under 2 or in pregnancy without advice.

ssd.use: Prescription cream used on certain burns to prevent infection.
warnings: Avoid with sulfonamide ("sulfa") allergy.
Not for use in late pregnancy or newborns.

mupirocin.use: Prescription topical antibiotic for certain localised bacterial skin infections.
warnings: Use for the prescribed duration only (resistance risk).

fusidic.use: Prescription topical antibiotic for certain localised skin infections.
warnings: Short courses only (resistance risk).

chloramphenicolEye.use: Antibiotic eye drops for bacterial conjunctivitis (classification varies by country).
warnings: Refer red, painful eye with blurred vision or light sensitivity urgently.
Discard after course/opening as per label.

insulinHuman.use: Prescription insulin used to control blood glucose in diabetes.
warnings: Store unopened in fridge 2–8 °C; never freeze.
In-use vials/pens may be kept at room temperature for a limited time per label.
Hypoglycaemia risk — know the signs.
Store unopened in fridge 2–8 °C; never freeze.
Do not mix with other insulins in the same syringe.

latanoprost.use: Prescription eye drops used to lower eye pressure in glaucoma.
warnings: Unopened bottles refrigerated; after opening follow label (commonly room temperature up to 4 weeks).
May darken iris colour.

tetanus.use: Vaccine given by a qualified health professional to protect against tetanus.
warnings: Maintain the cold chain 2–8 °C at all times; do not freeze.
Administered only by trained professionals.

probioticCold.use: Dietary probiotic supplement that requires refrigeration.
warnings: Keep refrigerated after purchase as per label.
